run.why_two: The 7-day pull returned 36 notices but only ONE with 10+ days of runway — not enough to build a batch. A 30-day pull (also one metered request; fetch_opportunities is a single call regardless of window) returned 106 notices and 4 with 10+ days. Budget had reset (ledger last dated 2026-09-03), so 8 of 10 remain.

supply_finding.headline: NAICS 541519 produces almost no briefable, small-business-relevant, long-runway work.
supply_finding.interpretation: There was NO notice in the entire month that was both a small-business set-aside and had ten days left to respond. Three of the five notices this batch is built on have a blank set-aside field, stated plainly in the briefs and never read as full-and-open. The niche scored well on notice COUNT (117/30d at pick time); usable supply is a different and much smaller number. This is a niche-selection problem, not a pipeline bug, and it bears on whether a weekly cadence can be promised.
options_for_founder: widen the ingest window as standing practice (costs nothing extra — one request either way)
add the 561210 fallback niche or a second NAICS to thicken supply
relax the 10-day bar to ~7 days and send faster after each pull
